reports.title: Anglers Enjoy Marathon of Great Weather
reports.text:
Light winds teamed up with mild temperatures to provide excellent fishing conditions for bass and crappie anglers as October faded away and passed the torch on to November.
Crappie fishing has been good lately and some hefty stringers have been taken. Depths of 12 to 15 feet were producing but several anglers have reported success from the 9 to 12 foot range at times. Up Big Sandy and into West Sandy some crappie have been caught in 6 to 8 foot depths at times. However, the shallow bite has been slow to get going this fall as most fish are opting to hold out a bit deeper. A few cloudy rainy days would likely stimulate more crappie to move up to shallower depths as would lower surface temps…

reports.title: Bass Techniques for Heat Wave on Kentucky Lake
reports.text:
Bass Techniques for Heat Wave on Kentucky Lake
Last year the August heat wave slowed down the progression of shad moving to the shallow flats and also slowed down the bass feeding in the shallow flat water. This year the shad and bass are feeding well in the shallow flats even with the heat wave. I have a few places where bass are feeding all day in super shallow water even with the sun up and high.
I typically fish water that is 3 foot to 6 inches when I am going after the shallow bass that August 1st brings us.
The summer largemouth ledge fishing on Kentucky Lake starts getting tougher during the end of July but there are still super deep ledge fish in August and shallow ledge fish.
